import { ArgTypes, Meta, Canvas } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks'; import * as CardStories from './Card.stories'; # Card [Source code](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon/tree/main/packages/react/src/components/Card)   {/* */} ## Table of Contents - [Overview](#overview) - [Subcomponents](#subcomponents) - [Density](#density) - [Clickable cards](#clickable-cards) - [Disabled state](#disabled-state) - [Media](#media) - [Header actions](#header-actions) - [AI label](#ai-label) - [Horizontal layout](#horizontal-layout) - [Component API](#component-api) - [Feedback](#feedback) {/* */} ## Overview The `Card` component is a flexible container for displaying related content and actions. Cards are composed from a set of subcomponents — `Card.Header`, `Card.Body`, `Card.Footer`, `Card.Media`, and more — that slot into a structured layout. ```jsx import { Card } from '@carbon/react'; function Example() { return ( Card title

Card body content.

 ); } ``` ## Subcomponents | Subcomponent | Alias | Purpose | | ----------------- | ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `CardHeader` | `Card.Header` | Contains title, media, and actions | | `CardBody` | `Card.Body` | Primary content area | | `CardFooter` | `Card.Footer` | Bottom action bar | | `CardMedia` | `Card.Media` | Image/video slot (aspect ratio wrapper) | | `CardHeaderMedia` | `Card.HeaderMedia` | Icon/image slot spanning the full header width above the title | | `CardTitleMedia` | `Card.TitleMedia` | Media slot to the left of the title | | `CardTitle` | `Card.Title` | Primary heading text; accepts `label` and `description` props for sub-text | | `CardActions` | `Card.Actions` | Action button group in the header | | `CardAction` | `Card.Action` | Individual action wrapper (footer or header) | ## Density Cards support two density variants via the `density` prop: - **`productive`** (default) — uses `$heading-compact-02` for a compact layout - **`expressive`** — uses `$heading-03` for a more spacious layout ## Clickable cards A clickable card turns the entire surface into a single action target. Pass `clickable` to enable interactive styles (hover, focus, active states) and a built-in footer affordance with an arrow icon. Every clickable card **must have an accessible name** via `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` — a `console.error` is raised at runtime if this is missing. `Card.Footer` is not supported inside a clickable card and will render nothing. The footer affordance is managed by the card itself. ### Action card (onClick) Use `onClick` when the card triggers an in-page action such as opening a modal, selecting an item, or expanding a panel. ```jsx openModal()} aria-label="View analytics report"> Usage report Content ``` ### Navigation card (as="a") Use `as="a"` with `href` when the card navigates to another page. This renders a native `` element giving users right-click, Cmd+click, and screen-reader link semantics. ```jsx Dashboard Content ``` Use any router's Link component the same way: ```jsx // React Router ... ``` ### Custom footer icon Override the default `ArrowRight` icon using `renderFooterIcon`: ```jsx ... ``` ## Disabled state Pass `disabled` to mute the card visually and prevent all interaction. Manually pass `disabled` to any interactive elements inside the card (buttons, inputs) since the card itself does not propagate the disabled state. ## Media Use `Card.Media` with a `ratio` prop to render an aspect-ratio-constrained media slot. Supported ratios are those accepted by the Carbon `AspectRatio` component (`16x9`, `9x16`, `2x1`, `1x2`, `4x3`, `3x4`, `1x1`). Place `Card.Media` inside `Card.Header` for a top-positioned image, or as a direct child of `Card` with the `horizontal` prop for a side-by-side layout. ## Header actions Place `Card.Actions` inside `Card.Header` to add icon or text buttons right-aligned in the header row. ## AI label Pass an `AILabel` to the `decorator` prop to render an AI label in the top-right corner of the card with a gradient border treatment. ## Horizontal layout Pass `horizontal` to the `Card` to render media and content side-by-side. `Card.Media` must be a direct child of `Card` (not nested in `Card.Header`). Use `mediaWidth` on `Card.Media` to control the media column width (default: `33.33%`). ## Component API ## Feedback Help us improve this component by providing feedback, asking questions on Slack, or updating this file on [GitHub](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon/edit/main/packages/react/src/components/Card/Card.mdx).

examples.name: Disabled
examples.code:
export const Disabled = () => {
  const [disabled, setDisabled] = React.useState(true);
  return (
    <Grid withRowGap>
      <Column lg={4} md={4} sm={4}>
        <Card disabled={disabled}>
          <Card.Header>
            <Card.Title>Card Title</Card.Title>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Body>
            When the card is disabled, pass the same state to all interactive
            elements inside — buttons, inputs, toggles, etc.
          </Card.Body>
          <Card.Footer>
            <Card.Action>
              <Button kind="ghost" size="md" disabled={disabled}>
                Action
              </Button>
            </Card.Action>
            <Card.Action>
              <IconButton
                label="Download"
                kind="ghost"
                size="md"
                disabled={disabled}>
                <Download />
              </IconButton>
            </Card.Action>
          </Card.Footer>
        </Card>
      </Column>
      <Column lg={4} md={4} sm={4} className="card-story-disabled-toggle">
        <Button
          kind="tertiary"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => setDisabled((d) => !d)}>
          {!disabled ? 'Disable Card' : 'Enable Card'}
        </Button>
      </Column>
    </Grid>
  );
};

Disabled.argTypes = readonlyArgTypes;
